market_report.headline: Activity steadies as new supply tapers and tenants return to 100k+ SF requirements.
market_report.data_note: Sample / placeholder data — replace with current CoStar export.
takeaways: Construction pipeline has compressed sharply — speculative starts down ~40% from 2024 peak, signaling supply discipline through 2027.
Big-box (200k+ SF) requirements have returned in the I-94 / I-275 corridors after 18 months of quiet, driven by 3PL and EV-supply-chain users.
Ann Arbor / Saline remains the tightest market — sub-5% vacancy and the highest NNN rates in the region.
Cap rates have stabilized in the 6.75%–7.50% range for stabilized Class A industrial.
market_report.watching_body: several Tier-1 occupiers are reviewing footprint commitments as OEM production schedules slip. Expect sublease availability to tick up in Romulus and Brownstown in the next two quarters — could create opportunity for tenants with timing flexibility.

markets.summary: Light manufacturing, flex and distribution space close to I-275 and M-14.
intro: Plymouth and Plymouth Township sit in western Wayne County with direct access to I-275 and M-14. The area has a mix of established industrial parks, flex buildings and newer distribution space, and it draws users who want to stay between Detroit and Ann Arbor.

Because the corridor crosses several cities and townships, zoning, taxes and building types can change from one exit to the next. Drake helps owners, tenants and buyers compare options across the corridor and focus on the sites that fit their operation.

faqs.q: How does Drake help owners sell or lease an industrial building?
faqs.a: Disposition starts with a walkthrough and a review of the building, the market and your goals. From there Drake builds a pricing and marketing plan, lists the property on CPIX and other industrial channels, reaches out to likely buyers or tenants, and manages tours, offers, negotiation and due diligence through closing or lease signing.

faqs.q: How does an acquisition search work for owner users and investors?
faqs.a: It begins with a clear list of requirements, such as size, clear height, power, loading, yard, zoning, location and budget. Drake then searches listed and off market options, sets up tours, helps compare buildings side by side, and negotiates the purchase. He also helps coordinate inspections, environmental review, title and financing timing so the deal can close on schedule.

faqs.q: What is a build-to-suit and when does it make sense?
faqs.a: A build-to-suit is a new facility designed and built around a specific user. It can make sense when no existing building meets your needs, or when your operation needs special features like heavy power, high clear height or extra loading. Drake helps with site selection, entitlements and coordination with developers and contractors, and can compare build-to-suit options with existing buildings.

faqs.q: How long does it take to lease industrial space?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the space, how many options fit, the condition of the building and how much work is needed before move in. A simple lease of a ready space can move quickly, while larger spaces or spaces that need improvements often take longer. Starting early gives you more choices and more negotiating room, so it is smart to reach out well before your current lease ends.

faqs.q: What should I have ready before I start a search?
faqs.a: Helpful details include the size you need, ceiling height, number and type of loading doors, power, parking and yard needs, preferred areas, budget, and your move in date. If you are buying, it also helps to know your financing plan. Drake can help you work through any of these if you are not sure yet.

faqs.q: Do you represent tenants, buyers, landlords and sellers?
faqs.a: Yes. Drake represents owners on disposition and leasing, and represents buyers and tenants on acquisitions and leases. On every assignment the representation is confirmed in writing at the start so everyone knows who is represented.

Drake focuses on industrial property in Plymouth, Livonia, Canton, Ann Arbor, Saline, Novi, Northville, Wixom, the I-275 corridor and greater Metro Detroit. Through Signature Associates he also handles assignments in other parts of Michigan and the region.
